text:
maria_support: FYI customer dispute - invoice shows ~3x embeddings charged vs what dashboard reports. They say they called embeddings + rerank in same job. Can someone triage?

zach_customer: We uploaded a CSV of 1,200 docs, dashboard shows 1,200 embedding rows. Invoice line item is for 3,600 embedding units. Request ids: rid-20260301-11, rid-20260301-22, rid-20260301-33.

maria_support: Customer attached a minimal repro and timestamps. They call `POST /v1/embeddings` in batches and then `POST /v1/rerank` in pairwise mode over the same set. They claim invoice counts = embeddings + 2*rerank (i.e., rerank counted pairwise as separate embeddings).

sam_eng: Can you paste an example request (body) and one of the request ids so I can grep logs? Also which model (name) are they using?

maria_support: Model is `rdx-embed-1` for embeddings and `rdx-rerank-1` for rerank. Example excerpt below: 
```
# embeddings batch (curl)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -d '{"model":"rdx-embed-1","input":["doc1 text...","doc2 text...","doc3 text..."]}'

# rerank pairwise call
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -d '{"model":"rdx-rerank-1","pairs":[{"input":"query","candidate":"doc1"}, {"input":"query","candidate":"doc2"}]}'
```

ina_sre: Quick note: we have an internal fallback where rerank will compute embeddings if candidate dims mismatch or truncation happened. That can trigger an internal embeddings request. If that internal call is erroneously attributed to the customer, it would double-count.

sam_eng: I grepped logs for `rid-20260301-11` and see this sequence: first a customer embeddings batch (status 200), then a rerank request, then an internal helper embeddings call flagged `helper=true`. But the metering event for helper call has `acct_id` set to the customer account instead of `system_account`.

sam_eng: Log snippet: 
```
[t=2026-03-01T11:02:03Z] RID=rid-20260301-11 type=embeddings batch=1200 status=200 acct=acct-88
[t=2026-03-01T11:02:15Z] RID=rid-20260301-11 type=rerank pairwise pairs=1199 status=200 acct=acct-88
[t=2026-03-01T11:02:15Z] INTERNAL helper=embeddings cause=truncation-fallback pairs_recomputed=1199 acct=acct-88 meter_tag=embedding units=1199
```

jon_billing: That last line explains the 3x: embeddings batch (1,200) + rerank pairwise (internal counts 1,199) flagged as embeddings again. We should be billing: customer embeddings batch + rerank invoice (if rerank is a billable product) but NOT double-count internal helper calls. Is rerank currently billed as token/embedding units or as an independent rerank unit?

maria_support: Customer says they were expecting only one embeddings line + rerank line (not extra embeddings).

sam_eng: Looks like a meter attribution bug: helper calls are emitted with the customer's acct_id in the meter pipeline. I'll open an internal bug for metering attribution and add a repro script to the ticket.

jon_billing: Please also add a quick sql to compute delta between dashboard_count and invoice_count for that acct and timeframe so we can calculate credit amount.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BILL-3921 "metering: internal helper embeddings attributed to customer account causing duplicate charges" assigned to @sam_eng.

maria_support: Customer asked for an interim credit while you triage. Can we provide a provisional refund for the extra ~2,400 units (invoice shows 3,600 vs dashboard 1,200)?

jon_billing: I'll provision a one-off credit pending root cause. Need the exact invoice line id and the delta calc. Maria, can you DM me the invoice id?

ina_sre: Remediation plan: 1) patch metering pipeline to enforce `helper` calls map to `system_account` before aggregation (hotfix) 2) add server-side dedupe for embedding meter events where the same RID + helper flag appears within 30s 3) add test to prevent regression. ETA for hotfix: 48h.

sam_eng: Repro script included in BUG-2467 (attached). Steps to reproduce locally: send a batch of long docs that trigger truncation, then call pairwise rerank. We see the helper embeddings call. Patch in branch `meter/ignore-helper` fixes attribution.

zach_customer: Thanks, appreciate quick traction. We'll share the CSV and timestamps. Please keep our billing contact looped.

maria_support: Noted. I'll escalate the credit and keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
